name: University of Sydney
quote: The University's standard English language proficiency requirement is set at an IELTS overall score of 6.5 with no band below 6.0; however, some faculties and courses have different requirements.

name: University of Sydney
quote: For other English tests accepted by the University, please refer to the English language concordance table (pdf, 220KB) to convert the IELTS requirements to TOEFL iBT (TOEFL Home Edition is not accepted), PTE, LanguageCert Academic (in-person), Cambridge C1 Advanced or Cambridge C2 Proficiency scores.
